milestone.title: Backlog
milestone.description: Milestone for triaged issues that have not yet been scheduled for resolution.

issue.body: https://www.google.com/search?q=PAGE+NOT+FOUND+site%3Aangular.io Most of these pages should have a redirect setup to a correct page or should return HTTP 404 to signal that the page doesn't exist (dgeni knows about all the urls, so we can generate firebase config that will do this for us).

body: Here is a doc that (I think) covers all the redirects we need to add: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a2SNr1LOAJqo4dBpt9-bcUYuiMtYmmdGutgILceNi9Q/edit#gid=0

Which should result in the following redirects being required:

```
/**/AnimationStateDeclarationMetadata*                        /api/animation
/**/cookbook/ts-to-js*                                        https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/aio/content/guide/change-log.md#es6--described-in-typescript-to-javascript-2016-11-14
/**/CORE_DIRECTIVES*                                          /api/common
/**/DirectiveMetadata-*                                       /api/core/Directive
/**/HTTP_PROVIDERS*                                           /api/http/HttpModule
/**/MaxLengthValidator*                                       /api/forms/MaxLengthValidator
/**/NgFor-*                                                   /api/common/NgForOf
/**/PLATFORM_PIPES*                                           /api/common
/api/:package/:api-*                                          /api/:package/:api
/api/:package/testing/index/:api-*                            /api/:package/testing/:api
/api/common/Control-*                                         /api/forms/FormControl
/api/common/SelectControlValueAccessor-*                      /api/forms/SelectControlValueAccessor
/api/platform-browser/AnimationDriver                         /api/animations/browser/AnimationDriver
/api/testing/:api-*                                           /api/core/testing/:api
/api/upgrade/:package/:api-*                                  /api/upgrade/:package/:api
/api/upgrade/:package/index/:api-*                            /api/upgrade/:package/:api
/docs/*/latest/api/:package                                   /api/:package
/docs/*/latest/api/:package/:api-*                            /api/:package/:api
/docs/*/latest/api/:package/index/:api-*                      /api/:package/:api
/docs/*/latest/api/:package/testing                           /api/:package/testing
/docs/*/latest/api/:package/testing/index/:api-*              /api/:package/testing/:api
/docs/*/latest/api/common/ControlGroup                        /api/forms/FormGroup
/docs/*/latest/api/platform-browser/animations/index/:api-*   /api/platform-browser/animations/:api
/docs/*/latest/api/testing/:api-*                             /api/core/testing/:api
/docs/*/latest/api/upgrade/:package/:api-*                    /api/upgrade/:package/:api
/docs/*/latest/api/upgrade/:package/index/:api-*              /api/upgrade/:package/:api
/docs/*/latest/glossary                                       /guide/glossary
/docs/js/latest/api                                           /api
/docs/latest/tutorial                                         /guide/tutorial
/docs/styleguide*                                             /guide/styleguide
/guide/learning-angular*                                      /guide/quickstart
/news*                                                        https://blog.angular.io/
/testing                                                      /guide/testing
/testing/**                                                   /guide/testing
api/api/:rest*                                                api/:rest
docs/*/latest/guide/                                          /guide/
docs/*/latest/guide/lifecycle-hooks                           /guide/lifecycle-hooks
docs/*/latest/guide/ngmodule                                  /guide/ngmodules
docs/*/latest/resources                                       /resources
```

I was worried that `/api/:package/:api-*  ->> /api/:package/:api` is going to match even valid urls that shouldn't be redirected? But then I checked and we don't have any with `-` in the name. Yay! the rest looks good to me.

Maybe also add a link to https://v2.angular.io/docs/ts/latest/cookbook/ts-to-js.html in https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/aio/content/guide/change-log.md#es6--described-in-typescript-to-javascript-2016-11-14.

##
> docs/*/latest/guide/                                          /guide/
docs/*/latest/guide/lifecycle-hooks                           /guide/lifecycle-hooks
docs/*/latest/guide/ngmodule                                  /guide/ngmodules
docs/*/latest/resources                                       /resources

We have a rule that redirects `/docs/ts/latest/:any*` to `/:any*`. We could relax it to match both `js` as well as `ts` and it would match the 4 cases above:

```diff
{"type": 301, "source": "/docs/ts/latest/:any*", "destination": "/:any*"},
{"type": 301, "source": "/docs/*/latest/:any*", "destination": "/:any*"},
```

The rest LGTM too ✨
I am working on this and the associated service worker routes.

issue.body: Closes #21377 The new regex for the Service Worker - the aim of which is to force a trip to the server for URLs that should be redirected - can be viewed on Debuggex: https://www.debuggex.com/r/V3bYY6Ny8XVY46Z8 We should really implement some form of testing for these redirects on both firebase and the service worker.
